ppp_policy.description: FrankPass strictly enforces localized Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) across 228 countries. Developing and South Asian nations receive fair sovereign regional rates to eliminate currency barriers. FrankPass DOES NOT charge flat $25 USD converted in developing nations.
ppp_policy.edge_fx_update_frequency: Every 6 hours via Cloudflare Edge Cache

active_promotions.scope: Valid on all 228 localized currency rates
active_promotions.community_advocate_discount: 75% OFF ($6.25 USD base or local PPP equivalent) for verified students, educators, and open-source advocates

replacement_policy.discount: 50% OFF replacement license ($12.50 USD or local PPP equivalent)
replacement_policy.terms: Strictly once in a lifetime per customer in case of physical motherboard failure or PC hardware upgrade
